$comment: Manifest of license-lifecycle nag templates. The runtime (Glenn's gate primitives per Richard's capability-composition-plan-v1 ADR-211), the operator portal preview (Nancy), the public docs (Heather), and counsel review all read this catalog. The body field of each entry points to the canonical .txt the runtime renders. Change the .txt to change the rendered wording; never re-author wording in a consumer surface. This file is a JSON array per the docs-as-database pattern; the manifest schema validates each element individually.

variables.name: {productName}
variables.description: The customer-facing product name resolved from the prd claim on the demo license. Typically 'Pro Developer' or a marketing-trial product label.

templates.sourceOfTruth: docs/_wip/capability-composition-plan-v1.md Section 4.7 (Demo source 1 - issued demo, no escalation, no day counter)

variables.name: {productName}
variables.description: The customer-facing product name resolved from the prd claim on the expired license.

variables.name: {expirationDate}
variables.description: The date the license expired, formatted yyyy-mm-dd. Sourced from the exp claim on the license token.

variables.name: {x}
variables.description: Current day in the grace period, 1-31. The runtime increments per Richard's per-tenant state machine.

templates.sourceOfTruth: docs/_wip/capability-composition-plan-v1.md Section 4.7 (Expired progression days 1-30 - weekly nag, user-input acknowledgement required)

templates.displayName: Expired paid license - stern legal notice (day 32-60)

variables.name: {productName}
variables.description: The customer-facing product name resolved from the prd claim on the expired license.

variables.name: {x}
variables.description: Current day in the grace period, capped 1-60. The runtime increments per Richard's per-tenant state machine; day 32-60 selects this template.

templates.sourceOfTruth: docs/_wip/capability-composition-plan-v1.md Section 4.7 (Expired progression days 31-60 - daily nag, user-input required) and ADR-211

variables.name: {productName}
variables.description: The customer-facing product name resolved from the prd claim on the revoked license.

templates.sourceOfTruth: docs/_wip/capability-composition-plan-v1.md Section 4.8 (Revoked progression - immediate hard-fail on next refresh or restart, no grace period)
templates.restatesClauseFrom: prose/licensing/legal/agreements/pro-license-agreement.md Section 10 (Term and Termination) and Section 8 (Limitation of Liability)
